name: Warlock

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: A Warlock may use Ruin Actions. They may activate the Move Ruin Action during their own turn.

bonuses.name: Intense Emotions
bonuses.text: This Threat takes a penalty of +1 DN to all Resolve Tests.

abilities.name: Runes of Battle
abilities.text: The Warlock may attempt to activate one of the following psychic powers: Smite (Wrath & Glory, page 272), any Runes of Battle power (page 283), Conceal (below).

abilities.name: Conceal
abilities.text: DN 5, Action, Sustained. While sustained, allies within 5 m gain +1 Defence and +1 bonus dice on Stealth (A) Tests. Spend 3 Shifts per additional +1 Defence and +21 on Stealth (A) Tests.

abilities.name: The Path of the Seer
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to activate a Psychic Power or Deny the Witch (Wrath & Glory page 267).

determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 3d6. Warlocks can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: Conceal's '+21 on Stealth (A) Tests' printed as is. The Path of the Seer sidebar (Perils of the Warp for Aeldari psykers) is rules text, not transcribed. Champion prints no personal Ruin number.
